description: Source code implementing virtual input event handlers and a controller class for IPC communication, including functions to open, close, and dispose of the virtual input controller.

classes.name: KeyEventHandler
classes.description: Handles key events via IPC, invoking a callback with action and code.

classes.name: MouseEventHandler
classes.description: Handles mouse events via IPC, invoking a callback with action, button, horizontal, and vertical parameters.

classes.name: TouchEventHandler
classes.description: Handles touch events via IPC, invoking a callback with action, index, X, and Y parameters.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Manages IPC channels for virtual input events, registering handlers for key, mouse, and touch events, and providing functions to open, close, and dispose of the controller.

classes.name: NameEventHandler
classes.description: Handles name messages via IPC, setting name and mode in response.

methods.name: virtualinput_open
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Controller instance for virtual input IPC communication.

methods.name: virtualinput_close
methods.description: Deletes the Controller instance, closing IPC channels.

methods.name: virtualinput_dispose
methods.description: Disposes of singleton resources related to IPC.
